name: Parkland
dining_districts: the Heron Bay and Parkland Golf & Country Club dining rooms
the Loxahatchee Road corridor toward the Everglades edge
intro: Parkland sits at Broward's quiet northwest edge — a low-density, high-expectation city where most professional cooking happens inside country club dining rooms and a handful of upscale plaza restaurants. Club members here eat like regulars because they are: the same faces at lunch after golf, the same families at Sunday dinner, and a member survey waiting for any kitchen that slips.

Member-grade consistency is a produce spec, not a slogan — same size, same trim, same ripeness, every case. Club chefs run standing orders against that spec and use split cases for wine dinners, member-guest tournaments, and holiday banquets. Parkland caps the northwest run out of Pompano Beach, about twenty-five minutes door to door.
route_note: About 25 minutes from our Pompano Beach warehouse at the top of the northwest Broward run — club and plaza stops land well before lunch.

faqs_unique.q: Can you hold consistent produce specs for Parkland club kitchens?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. Standing orders lock a spec — size, trim, ripeness — and our team flags substitutions before they ship, not after they arrive.

faqs_unique.q: Do you handle tournament and banquet volume for Parkland clubs?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. Layer event volume on top of your standing baseline by the midnight cutoff — member-guest weekends and holiday banquets are routine adds.

cta_text: Tell us your member covers, event calendar, and produce spec — we will keep a Parkland club kitchen consistent enough that nobody notices, which is the point.
